ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity dark pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant high-intensity contiguous white region located on the upper-left lobe. The right lobe is predominantly low-intensity dark with localized mottling of high-intensity pixels along the upper margin and near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped central notch with an approximate internal angle of 55 degrees and a bounding-box depth extending roughly 12% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serrations present across both lobes, characterized by sharp peaks and deep valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced upward concave curve extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly distinct clusters of high-intensity white circular pixel groups localized on the extreme distal tips of both lobes, consistent with dense barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several vertical low-intensity linear pixel disruptions (scratches) are visible against the high-intensity white patch on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on both lateral tips; vertical linear scarring on the left ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density of barnacles on the fluke tips significantly alters the expected smooth geometric contour of the distal margins.
